<?php
function defined_ctrl5() {
    $subject = 0;
    declare(ticks=0);
    switch (@$subject) {
        case ($subject = 2):
            echo "BAD-LATE|";
            break;
        default:
            echo "DEFINED|", $subject, "|";
    }
    return $subject;
}
$value = defined_ctrl5();
echo "RESULT|", $value, "|";

<?php
function missing_ctrl5() {
    declare(ticks=0);
    switch (@$missing) {
        case ($missing = 1):
            echo "BAD-LATE|";
            break;
        default:
            echo "MISSING|", $missing, "|";
    }
    return $missing;
}
$value = missing_ctrl5();
echo "RESULT|", $value, "|";
